entry_item.definition: ( plural of nom) . The word nom ( S. dharma) acquired a very special meaning as a philosophical term by designating the irreducible elements for the construction of a pluralistic world conception comprising botli external and internal phenomena. There are various attemps at rendering this term in English, such as 'element, ''essence', 'mental dates', 'mentals', none of them is quite satisfactory. Datum pl. data, might perhaps be acceptable, if one ignores the fact that a datum, by its very etymology, presupposes a subject. On account of this difficulty the M. term nom ud has been retained in this word list.
